We originally spoke with another company who used good products but the quote seemed high for the 6.6kW system they were suggesting. SolarQuotes suggested we get additional quotes. We went through all their reviews and found EISS who had plenty of good reviews. We reached out to them and though we couldn't speak with them immediately as they were on the job working, the messaged and we spoke later that evening.The advised that a 6.6kW system wouldn't meet our needs as we wouldn't be able to maximize the 5kW back into the grid especially during high use periods. They suggested as a minimum a 10kW system with an 8kW inverter. At first I thought they were just trying to upsell but then their quote was actually $1000 less than the other quote using a superior inverter along with a smart meter. It was definitely a lot easier than I'd expected. We only had to sign the contract and they did the rest. We can honestly recommend this company and their customer service. Just a pleasure to deal with. Thank you too SolarQuotes.

What a great experience it was organizing our residential solar install with EISS. I did extensive research in choosing a solar provider and couldn’t be happier I went with the team at EISS. They explained the process clearly and helped me setup the app to monitor my energy management. We recently had a 15 kW solar panel system with a 38 kWh battery installed by EISS, and the entire experience has been exceptional. Having had solar installed on our last four homes, we can confidently say this was the smoothest and easiest process we’ve ever experienced.We chose EISS based on their stellar reviews and reputation, rather than going with a company that door-knocks or cold-calls. I called EISS on a Monday to get a quote, and by Friday lunchtime, I was already enjoying my new favorite pastime: watching solar power flow into the battery icon on my SolarWeb app. It’s hypnotic to see the little dots whirl around and the numbers climb, knowing it represents how much energy we can use without ever worrying about our next electricity bill.The installers arrived on time and completed the installation as scheduled. They handled everything professionally and explained the process as they went along. They listened to my requests for a system design based on our previous installs and offered valuable advice on making it better, cheaper, and more efficient. After sending through the quote, they promptly organized a day for the installation.EISS’s professionalism, timeliness, and attention to detail made this solar installation an incredibly positive experience. We are thrilled with the performance of our new solar system and highly recommend EISS for anyone considering solar power.

Very happy with the entire service, from quoting and advice through to approval and after sales service.The team turned up on time on the day they had booked in with no changes to start dates even with bad weather around.The install looks fantastic, even and symmetrical.The team worked in seamless with removal of an old system, roof restoration and then the new install.The system is already producing great results and more than happy that I have gone with the right company.

It has been a pleasure dealing with EISS. They were the first to respond to my SolarQuotes quotation request, and all subsequent communications were always done in a timely manner - not just during "pre-sales" but also after I had booked the job. Of course, the information and explanation I received regarding my options (e.g. different types/levels of blackout back-up options) was good and EISS was upfront with me on the type of system they believed in the most.During the time between paying the deposit and the actual installation date, EISS kept me informed on what was going on and sent me a reminder a few days before - this was reassuring that the installation team would certainly turn up at the appointed time, which they certainly did on the day itself. The weather was a bit wetter than forecast, but the installers worked out a plan with me to return to finish the job. I was kept informed throughout the process and sure enough, they came back exactly as agreed.Luke and the boys were courteous and did a tidy installation job both on the roof and at the switchboard level. Panels were mounted neatly and look great from the street. Wall and roof penetrations were kept to what was absolutely necessary only, and no exposed conduit was used. They cleaned up the job site quite thoroughly after they were done, and Luke showed me how to monitor what the inverter and relay was doing. Lauren helped organise the grid connection right after the install, so I could start getting credited for exported energy just days after that.So far, the system's operation exceeds expectations, and my property is practically energy self-sufficient even on cloudy late autumn days. I look forward to updating my review from a reliability perspective in a few months' time.
Their service is fantastic. Highly recommend. Even after finished installed solar panels they helped me and advised about EWR.Solar system is working very well.
From start to finish I couldn't have asked for anything to be done better. Great communication, rocked up on time and by lunch everything was up and running.

I would highly recommend to anyone to use them for all the solar needs.
